lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (monthly) field assessments and compiled Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) data for El Salvador during 2020. Geographic boundaries and IPC phase classifications were collected for October, November, and December 2020 and distributed as GeoJSON and KML files to represent spatial variation in acute food insecurity across administrative units.
